name: evsoc_nissan_leaf_evcan
description: Nissan Leaf ZE0/AZE0 (2011-2017): listening to the battery frame 0x55B on the EV-CAN, which is on OBD pins 12/13 (not 6/14). SoC as a 10-bit value in 0.1 % (BMS nominal value, never reaches 0/100 % because of the buffer). Needs an adapter that reaches pins 12/13: evsoc box or CAN interface with a Leaf cable. For diagnostics over 6/14 there is obdb_nissan_leaf.
